answer_2.quote: We use the perplexity on GPT-2, a large Transformer language model trained on massive texts, to evaluate the fluency of the generated sentences... We use BERTScore as another reward in learning to evaluate the similarity between two sentences at the meaning level... We evaluate the attacking success rates at the token level and sentence level. The token level attacking success rate is the percentage of words [...] The sentence-level attacking success rate is the percentage of mispredicted sentences...

answer_4.quote: All the volunteers have a background of linguistic study and are proficient in English... For fluency, we ask them to rate the fluency of a sentence by an integer from 1 to 5... For attacking efficiency, we ask them to manually annotate erroneous dependency edges and calculate the error rate...
answer_4.guideline: Rate fluency on a 1‑5 scale; annotate erroneous dependency edges to compute error rates.
